In4mer2024.gi: observed pair log2FC minus sum of two measured singleton log2FC
In4mer2024.hit: dLFC < -1; author-defined effect-size rule; no P value or FDR claim
In4mer2024.platforms: K562/A549 prototype library; MELJUSO/A375 Inzolia library

Dede2020_reanalysis2024.gi: published deltaMean retained exactly, not recomputed from rounded singleton columns
Dede2020_reanalysis2024.hit: deltaMean < -1 and CohenD > 0.8; threshold from 2024 reanalysis
Dede2020_reanalysis2024.unmapped_source_pair_excluded: MPP2:MPP6 (MPP6 absent from project's approved HGNC symbol set)

preprocessing: HGNC symbol mapping; canonical unordered pairs; pairs only (triples/quads and ambiguous multigene names excluded); retain only finite pair and both-singleton phenotypes; no selection by hit status
single_gene_use: Frozen external scoring may use independently measured source singleton phenotypes; explicitly report this as conditional on observed singles. Do not fit or tune on external pairs.
nonhit_definition: measured pair not passing its source hit threshold; not a proven biological null; missing pairs are excluded, never encoded as zero/non-hit
applicability: Dede HT29 is colorectal pairwise evidence under basal growth. Other cohorts assess study/platform/cell-context transfer. No cohort contains oxaliplatin or an acquired-resistant cell state.
overlap_rule: Independent study can contain training-seen gene pairs. Report all-covered and pair-unseen subsets separately; no assertion of pair-level novelty from study independence alone.

COLO1_2025.role: already a training study; not independent external evaluation

Functional_modules.title: Functional modules predict genetic interactions, revealing evolutionary conservation and rewiring
Functional_modules.availability: Repository and public contents endpoint returned 404. No full measured gene-pair score table obtained; excluded from computational external validation.
Functional_modules.v2_reported_hit_rule: Zgi FDR < 0.25, normalized effect size > 0.15, and double knockout Zfc < -2
Functional_modules.literature_role: glycosylation network and 29-gene in vitro/3D/xenograft validation evidence; cannot calculate recall or FDR from a literature-only positive list
